name: E2E: Portal user creates incident via Agentforce full conversational flow
objective: Validate the complete incident creation workflow from portal login through Agentforce conversation to Salesforce record verification.
precondition: Portal user has valid credentials. Self-service portal is accessible. Agentforce chat widget is enabled.

steps.description: Navigate to ITSM portal and login with portal user credentials
steps.testData: URL from .env.dev BASE_URL, credentials from APP_USERNAME/APP_PASSWORD
steps.expectedResult: User is authenticated and redirected to the home page

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon (#embeddedMessagingConversationButton) on the home page
steps.expectedResult: Chat panel opens (iframe#embeddedMessagingFrame with class isMaximized)

steps.description: Send initial message requesting incident creation with issue description
steps.testData: I need to create an incident. My laptop is showing a blue screen error every time I open Microsoft Outlook. It started this morning after the Windows update.
steps.expectedResult: Agent asks for category selection from 25 available categories
Agent asks for subcategory from options: Business Application, Collaboration Tool, Data Platform, DevOps Tool, Operating System, Productivity Suite, Security Tool
Agent asks for brief description (at least 20 characters)

steps.testData: Blue screen error when opening Microsoft Outlook after Windows update
steps.expectedResult: Agent asks for detailed long description

steps.testData: Since this morning after the automatic Windows update (KB5039211), my laptop shows a Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) with error code KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR every time I try to open Microsoft Outlook. Other Office applications like Word and Excel work fine. I have restarted the laptop 3 times but the issue persists. My laptop model is Dell Latitude 5540 running Windows 11. This is blocking my work as I cannot access emails.
steps.expectedResult: Agent confirms incident created with INC-XXXXXXXXX number

steps.description: Verify incident number format in agent response
steps.expectedResult: Incident number matches pattern INC-\d{9} (e.g., INC-000001518)
